contents.title: Quiz Diagnostic 1ere Anglais - Serie 33
contents.subject: Anglais
contents.description: Diagnostic Anglais 1ere : Les temps du passé

questions.question: Choose the correct past tense: 'She ___ (finish) her exam two hours ago.'
'While I was walking home, it started to rain' correctly uses the past continuous and past simple together.
Mets les verbes entre parenthèses au bon temps du passé : 'By the time we arrived at the station, the train ___ (already/leave).'
Which sentence correctly uses the past perfect?
choices: She had left before he arrived.
She left before he had arrived.
She has left before he arrived.
She was leaving before he arrived.

questions.question: The past continuous can be used to describe two simultaneous actions happening at the same time in the past.
Explique pourquoi on utilise le past perfect dans cette phrase : 'When I got home, I realised I had forgotten my keys.'
Choose the correct sentence:
choices: I was watching TV when suddenly the lights went out.
I watched TV when suddenly the lights were going out.
I had been watching TV when suddenly the lights went out.
I watched TV when suddenly the lights go out.

questions.question: In English, irregular verbs have the same form for the past simple and the past participle.

exercisenotion.description: Le past simple exprime une action terminée à un moment précis du passé. Marqueurs : yesterday, last week/year, ago, in 2010, when I was young. Verbes réguliers : +ed. Verbes irréguliers : forme 2 (go→went, see→saw). Ex : She visited Paris last summer.

Le past continuous exprime une action en cours à un moment précis du passé, souvent interrompue par une autre action (past simple). Marqueurs : while, when, at that moment, at 8 o'clock yesterday. Ex : I was studying when she called. / While he was cooking, the phone rang.

Le past perfect exprime une action terminée AVANT une autre action passée. Il établit une chronologie dans le passé. Marqueurs : before, after, already, just, when, by the time. Structure : had + past participle. Ex : When I arrived, she had already left.
